name: In-browser example — gaze and face, the video never leaves the device
notes: Example of the features_in_browser tier: the capture page opens the camera
for the live engines and never creates a recording. The bundle is
session.json and browser_chunks.json only; the gaze estimator is fitted
on the features the browser computed. Only gaze and face can be offered
under this tier — every other engine needs the recording on a server.
A developer self-test (no audience): copy it to a new study_id, set
"audience": "participants" and fill in the ethics fields to use it.

disclosure.secondary_use: Analysed by the named research team only. Not sold, and not shared outside the team without a further, separate agreement.
disclosure.contact: Replace this with the investigator and the route to the ethics board before running anyone other than the developer.
